Collect session information

Source: R/session.R
session.Rd

Catalogs characteristics of the R session and execution environment.

Usage

session()

Value

A list with time, r_version, session_info, platform, machine, rng_kind, capabilities, external_software and graphics_software information.

Examples

s <- session()
str(s, 2)
